preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L[i] <= R[i] <= N for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each L[i] and R[i] must be within the bounds of the matrix.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= N for x, y in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query (x, y) must be within the bounds of the matrix.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'E' or 'O' for each query.
The number of output lines must match the number of queries.
